captions.caption: A fire burns inside a primitive clay oven.
A person's hand adds small sticks to the fire in the oven.
The hand adjusts the burning wood inside the clay structure.
Flames flicker within the dark opening of the clay oven.
Close up of the fire burning steadily inside the oven.
The camera pans across the exterior of the clay oven.
The top of the oven is shown with a flat stone surface.
The clay oven stands in a natural, sunlit environment.
A view from inside a dark hut looks out at the oven.
Close up of the rough texture of the clay oven's top.
A man enters the frame from behind a dark wall.
The man crouches down in the entrance of a hut.
The man's silhouette is visible against the bright outdoor light.
The man moves towards the camera in the dark space.
The man handles objects on the ground inside the hut.
The man stands up and prepares to go back outside.
The man walks out of the hut towards the oven.
The man picks up a clay cooking pan near the oven.
The man approaches the hot oven with the pan in hand.
Close up of the empty stone surface on top of the oven.
The man places a pan filled with chopped greens on the oven.
The man settles the pan onto the heated stone surface.
Close up of the vibrant green vegetables in the pan.
The man turns away from the oven to gather more items.
The man walks through green bushes near his hut.
The man stops to pick a yellow flower from a plant.
The man picks several yellow flowers and leaves.
The man examines the herbs he has just collected.
The man walks back towards the smoking clay oven.
The man places the flowers and herbs on the edge of the oven.
The pan of greens and a bowl of eggs sit on the oven.
A small bowl filled with quail eggs is placed on the oven.
The green vegetables sizzle on the hot cooking pan.
Close up of the speckled quail eggs in their bowl.
Close up of the chopped green vegetables in the pan.
Steam rises from the cooking green vegetables.
The bowl of eggs is positioned next to the pan of greens.
The man looks intently at the food cooking on the oven.
The man leans in to blow on the cooking surface.
The man continues to blow on the vegetables in the pan.
The man uses a wooden stick to stir the vegetables.
The man stirs the chopped greens to ensure even cooking.
Close up of the wooden stick stirring the green pieces.
The man continues stirring the vegetables on the hot pan.
The man spreads the vegetables across the stone surface.
The man's hand moves the stick back and forth.
The man stirs the vegetables one last time before stopping.
The man looks over the pan as the vegetables cook.
The man reaches for a small bowl of seasoning.
The man sprinkles a pinch of seasoning over the greens.
The man sprinkles seasoning over the green vegetables.
The man continues seasoning the food in the pan.
The man reaches for the bowl of speckled quail eggs.
The man picks up the first quail egg from the bowl.
The man cracks the first quail egg onto the greens.
The man finishes cracking the first egg and picks up another.
The man cracks a second quail egg over the vegetables.
The man cracks a third quail egg onto the pan.
The man cracks a fourth quail egg over the greens.
The man cracks a fifth quail egg onto the cooking food.
